title: Talent selected for DoorDash
intro: Prepared by Irvin Thevaranjan through the independent Ex-GH Talent Network. Eight public profiles paired with DoorDash recruiting opportunities reviewed October 20, 2026. These are potential alignments; interest, availability, eligibility, and role-specific requirements need confirmation. Some entries use general recruiting postings, and two marketing pages retain past expected-fill dates. Reply to Irvin to explore introductions.

items.note: Enterprise restaurant partner marketing, advertising, and growth experience align with co-marketing ownership. Confirm hands-on paid media and CRM execution, desired leadership scope, and active hiring status: the accessible posting lists a September expected-fill date.
